```lean
intro n
cases n mod 3 with r
have h0 : n ≡ 0 [mod 3] → ¬ 3 ∣ n ^ 2 + 1 :=
  assume h, 
  have h1 : n ^ 2 + 1 ≡ 1 [mod 3] := by rw [h, pow_mod, add_mod]; exact congr_arg (· mod 3) (add_right_inj (mod_eq_zero 3 1))
  not_div_iff_not_mod_eq_zero.2 h1
have h1 : n ≡ 1 [mod 3] → ¬ 3 ∣ n ^ 2 + 1 :=
  assume h, 
  have h2 : n ^ 2 + 1 ≡ 2 [mod 3] := by rw [h, pow_mod, add_mod]; exact congr_arg (· mod 3) (add_right_inj (mod_eq_zero 3 2))
  not_div_iff_not_mod_eq_zero.2 h2
have h2 : n ≡ 2 [mod 3] → ¬ 3 ∣ n ^ 2 + 1 :=
  assume h, 
  have h3 : n ^ 2 + 1 ≡ 2 [mod 3] := by rw [h, pow_mod, add_mod]; exact congr_arg (· mod 3) (add_right_inj (mod_eq_zero 3 2))
  not_div_iff_not_mod_eq_zero.2 h3
exact (if h : n ≡ 0 [mod 3] then h0 h else if h' : n ≡ 1 [mod 3] then h1 h' else h2 _)
```
